title: Babson, Louis Witten and Bryce DeWitt gravity institutes
place_text: Johns Hopkins; University of North Carolina, Chapel Hill

tellings.quote: Babson contacted Louis Witten, who was coming out of Johns Hopkins,

plain: Eric Weinstein, a researcher speaking on Jesse Michels's podcast in 2024, says that in the 1950s a man named Babson contacted Louis Witten, a physicist then coming out of Johns Hopkins University. According to Weinstein, this led to gravity research institutes involving Witten and another physicist, Bryce DeWitt, including at the University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill. He tells it as a sign of quiet early interest in mastering gravity.
